name: Backfield
description: - The backfield is located near Gate 6, situated in between the MPCC 1, Xavier Hall, and Jesuit Residences. This area is used for sports and outdoor activities.

name: JMRH
description: - The Jose Maria Rosauro SJ Hall is located behind the Jesuit Residences. A number of higher education offices can be found here, alongside the Rosendo U. Castillo, Jr. College of Law (RUCJ COL) facilities.

name: Jesuit Residence
description: - The Jesuit Residence is located behind the Learning Resources Center Building.

name: Learning Resource Center
description:
The Learning Resources Center is located near Gate 3. Several classrooms and offices can be found here, which include the following:
1st Floor: Carlos Dominguez Conference Hall (CDCH), Finance Office, University Athletics Office, and College Guidance & Counseling Office (CGCO)
2nd Floor: Higher Education Classrooms, 1st Floor Library, and Quality Assurance and Strategic Management Office (QASMO)
3rd Floor: Higher Education and School of Medicine (SOM) Classrooms, 2nd Floor Library, Archive Room, and Audio-Visual Rooms (AVR)
4th Floor: School of Medicine

name: Canisius & Gonzaga Bldg.
description:
The Canisius and Gonzaga Building (C) Building is located at the heart of the campus, situated in between the Belarmine and Campion Building (BC Building), Learning Resources Center (LRC), Multi-Purpose Covered Court 2 (MPCC 2), and Xavier Hall (XH Hall). Several classrooms and offices can be found here, which include the following:
1st Floor: C. Lobby, Office of Student Affairs, Science Laboratories, Lockers, College Registrar Office, School of Management and Accountancy (SMA) Office, and C. Garden 
2nd Floor:  School of Liberal Arts (SLA) Office, College of Nursing (CON) Office, College of Science, Information Technology, and Engineering (CSITE) Office, Faculty Lounge Area, Higher Education Classrooms, Science  Laboratories, and Animation Laboratory
3rd Floor: Center for Information and Technology Services (CITS) Office, Computer Laboratories, Science Laboratories, and Higher Education Classrooms
4th Floor: Higher Education Classrooms

name: Bellarmine & Campion Bldg.
description:
The Belarmine and Campion (BC) Building is located near Gate 2. Several classrooms and offices can be found here, which include the following:
1st Floor: Gallery of the Peninsula and the Archipelago (GPA), Infirmary, Office of the President, and Skills Laboratory 1
2nd Floor: Higher Education Classrooms 
3rd Floor: Higher Education Classrooms, Nursing Library, and Skills Laboratory 2
4th Floor: Higher Education Classrooms

name: University Church of Sacred Heart
description: - The Sacred Heart Chapel is located in front of the College Admissions and Aid Office near Gate 2. This is where masses are held.

name: Xavier Hall
description:
The Xavier Hall (XH) Hall is located behind the Belarmine and Campion (BC) Building. Several classrooms and offices can be found here, which include the following:
1st Floor: Muslim Prayer Rooms, El Consejo Atenista (ECA) Office, School of Education (SEd) Office, and Higher Education Classrooms 
2nd Floor: Higher Education Classrooms
3rd Floor: Higher Education Classrooms
4th Floor: Higher Education Classrooms

name: Sauras Hall
description:
The Xavier Hall (XH) Hall is located near the backfield. Several classrooms and offices can be found here, which include the following:
1st Floor: 1st Floor Cafeteria
2nd Floor: 2nd Floor Cafeteria
3rd Floor: Higher Education Classrooms, Student Dormitories, and Offices
4th Floor: Higher Education Classrooms 
5th Floor: Gym

name: MPCC-1
description: - The Multi-Purpose Covered Court 1 (MPCC 1) is located near Gate 6. In the 2nd floor, the PathFit Faculty Room and Dance Studio can be found.

name: MPCC-2
description: - The Multi-Purpose Covered Court 2 (MPCC 2) is located in front of the Kostka Building.

name: Kostka Bldg.
description: - The Kostka Building is located behind the Multi-Purpose Covered Court 2 (MPCC 2). Its four floors houses most of the Grade 11 classrooms.

name: FWS Building
description:
The Faustino W. Saavedra (FWS) Building is located near Gate 1. Several classrooms and offices can be found here, which include the following:
1st Floor: Senior High School (SHS) Chapel, Registrar Office, Infirmary, and Office of the Prefect of Discipline
2nd Floor: Senior High School (SHS) Classrooms, Senior High School (SHS) Library, Faculty Room, Office of Student Affairs, and Duffy Hall 
3rd Floor: Classrooms
4th Floor: Classrooms and Laboratories
5th Floor: Classrooms, Laboratories, and Multi-Purpose Hall (MPH)

name: Physical Plant Shop
description: - The Physical Plant Office is located near Gate 6, behind the Multi-Purpose Covered Court 1 (MPCC 1). Here, school maintenance is handled.
